verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes add/search/update/delete memory operations via API/SDK (client.add, client.search, customId-based updates, delete via container tag) and also offers an MCP server so agents can invoke these as tools mid-conversation, with runtime probes confirming the live API and hosted MCP endpoint. missing for 10: no hands-on/independent evidence of an agent actually invoking delete or update calls mid-conversation in practice, and community feedback raises friction (large-content ingestion limits, OAuth-only signin) that isn't directly about CRUD tool-calling but suggests some operational rough edges.
